title: Short Answer Questions
instructions: Provide detailed answers to the following questions. Readjust the text box size as needed

questions.prompt: Sum an Array: Write a method that takes in an array of integers and returns the sum of the elements. (2 pts)
Debugging: Describe all the tools you have to Debug in Unity.  (3 pts)

Rock Paper Scissors: Write a method that takes in two string parameters representing Rock, Paper, or Scissors and return a string indicating which one wins according to the rules of Rock Paper Scissors. Return "No Winner" if there is a tie. (5 pts)

Collisions: Write a method commonly used in Unity for checking collisions that would exist in a script (you only need to write the method). In the method, it should check if the object collided with has a Rigidbody component. If it does, destroy the object the script would be attached to. Otherwise, destroy the other object that collided with this one. (5 pts)

Input: Assume you have a GameObject called DummyPrefab and you are writing your code in the Update method. Write code that would create one of these prefabs at a random position where x is between -5f and 5f, y is 0f, and z = between -4f and 4f whenever you press the S key.
